parameters.name: cpus
parameters.description: Count of cpus to be assigned to new virtual instance. Choices: 1 2 4 8 16 32 56

parameters.name: datacenter
parameters.description: Datacenter for the virtual instance to be deployed. Choices: "ams01" "ams03" "che01" "dal01" "dal05" "dal06" "dal09" "dal10" "dal12" "dal13" "fra02" "fra04" "fra05" "hkg02" "hou02" "lon02" "lon04" "lon06" "mel01" "mex01" "mil01" "mon01" "osl01" "par01" "sao01" "sea01" "seo01" "sjc01" "sjc03" "sjc04" "sng01" "syd01" "syd04" "tok02" "tor01" "wdc01" "wdc04" "wdc06" "wdc07"

parameters.name: dedicated
parameters.description: Flag to determine if the instance should be deployed in dedicated space. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: disks
parameters.description: List of disk sizes to be assigned to new virtual instance. Default: [25]

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name to be provided to a virtual instance.

parameters.name: flavor
parameters.description: Specify which SoftLayer flavor template to use instead of cpus and memory.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Hostname to be provided to a virtual instance.

parameters.name: hourly
parameters.description: Flag to determine if the instance should be hourly billed. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: Image Template to be used for new virtual instance.

parameters.name: instance_id
parameters.description: Instance ID of the virtual instance to perform action option.

parameters.name: local_disk
parameters.description: Flag to determine if local disk should be used for the new instance. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: memory
parameters.description: Amount of memory to be assigned to new virtual instance. Choices: 1024 2048 4096 6144 8192 12288 16384 32768 49152 65536 131072 247808

parameters.name: nic_speed
parameters.description: NIC Speed to be assigned to new virtual instance. Choices: 10 100 1000

parameters.name: os_code
parameters.description: OS Code to be used for new virtual instance.

parameters.name: post_uri
parameters.description: URL of a post provisioning script to be loaded and executed on virtual instance.

parameters.name: private
parameters.description: Flag to determine if the instance should be private only. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: private_vlan
parameters.description: VLAN by its ID to be assigned to the private NIC.

parameters.name: public_vlan
parameters.description: VLAN by its ID to be assigned to the public NIC.

parameters.name: ssh_keys
parameters.description: List of ssh keys by their ID to be assigned to a virtual instance. Default: []

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create, or cancel a virtual instance. Specify present for create, absent to cancel. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tag or list of tags to be provided to a virtual instance.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Flag used to wait for active status before returning. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_time
parameters.description: Time in seconds before wait returns. Default: 600

examples:
- name: Build instance
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Build instance request
      community.general.sl_vm:
        hostname: instance-1
        domain: anydomain.com
        datacenter: dal09
        tags: ansible-module-test
        hourly: true
        private: false
        dedicated: false
        local_disk: true
        cpus: 1
        memory: 1024
        disks: [25]
        os_code: UBUNTU_LATEST
        wait: false

- name: Build additional instances
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Build instances request
      community.general.sl_vm:
        hostname: "{{ item.hostname }}"
        domain: "{{ item.domain }}"
        datacenter: "{{ item.datacenter }}"
        tags: "{{ item.tags }}"
        hourly: "{{ item.hourly }}"
        private: "{{ item.private }}"
        dedicated: "{{ item.dedicated }}"
        local_disk: "{{ item.local_disk }}"
        cpus: "{{ item.cpus }}"
        memory: "{{ item.memory }}"
        disks: "{{ item.disks }}"
        os_code: "{{ item.os_code }}"
        ssh_keys: "{{ item.ssh_keys }}"
        wait: "{{ item.wait }}"
      with_items:
        - hostname: instance-2
          domain: anydomain.com
          datacenter: dal09
          tags:
            - ansible-module-test
            - ansible-module-test-replicas
          hourly: true
          private: false
          dedicated: false
          local_disk: true
          cpus: 1
          memory: 1024
          disks:
            - 25
            - 100
          os_code: UBUNTU_LATEST
          ssh_keys: []
          wait: true
        - hostname: instance-3
          domain: anydomain.com
          datacenter: dal09
          tags:
            - ansible-module-test
            - ansible-module-test-replicas
          hourly: true
          private: false
          dedicated: false
          local_disk: true
          cpus: 1
          memory: 1024
          disks:
            - 25
            - 100
          os_code: UBUNTU_LATEST
          ssh_keys: []
          wait: true

- name: Cancel instances
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Cancel by tag
      community.general.sl_vm:
        state: absent
        tags: ansible-module-test
